Sri Lanka (Incorporation)

purposes of the Corporation in such manner and
upon  such  security  as  the  Committee  may  think
fit;
to levy fees, subscriptions  and contributions in
respect of membership, admission to membership,
renewal of membership and courses, conducted
by the Corporation;
to prescribe the terms and conditions of, and to
control the regulate the engagement, training and
dismissal of, persons desiring to qualify as Cricket
Umpires;
to appoint, employ, transfer, dismiss and exercise
disciplinary  control  over,  the  Officers  and
Servants  of  The  Corporation  and  to  pay  their
salaries, gratuities and allowances;
to  construct,  purchase,  maintain  and  repair
anything  required  for  the  purposes  of  the
Corporation;  and
to  take  all  such  steps  as  may  be  necessary  or
desirable for the promotion of all or any of the
objects of the Corporation.
